description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named BadBehaviorActivity, which contains various methods to intentionally cause problematic behaviors such as app crashes, ANRs, and resource consumption for testing purposes. It includes multiple nested classes for services, broadcast receivers, and a custom activity controller, as well as multiple UI button handlers that trigger disruptive actions.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that provides UI controls to trigger various disruptive or testing behaviors such as app crashes, ANRs, broadcast flood, and system hangs. It also contains nested classes for broadcast receivers, services, and activity control logic.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity.BadReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that logs and then sleep for 20 seconds, simulating a long-running broadcast handler.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity.BadService
classes.description: A service that sleeps for 30 seconds upon start, simulating a hung service.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity.BadController
classes.description: Custom implementation of IActivityController.Stub used to manipulate or hang system activities, using delays.

classes.name: BadBehaviorActivity.ExponentialReceiver
classes.description: Broadcast receiver used for flood testing; on receive, it sends multiple broadcasts recursively.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up button click handlers for various disruptive behaviors.
